Title: View schemes card on Home opens the View Schemes page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Click the View schemes card under the Schemes section.
Step Expected: The browser navigates to the address path /SchemeList.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
Step Expected: The h1 reads View Schemes.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the browser tab title.
Step Expected: The title reads Scheme list - Proficiency Testing.

Title: Scheme list shows the table columns and at least one scheme
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/SchemeList.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 View Schemes and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the table column headings.
Step Expected: The columns Scheme Code, Scheme Name, Participating and Current Contract Year are shown.

Step Action: Look at the rows below the column headings.
Step Expected: At least one scheme row is shown.

Step Action: Read the first scheme row.
Step Expected: The row has a value in the Scheme Code and Scheme Name columns.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still View Schemes.

Title: Scheme list keeps its heading after a reload
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/SchemeList.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 View Schemes.

Step Action: Read the browser tab title.
Step Expected: The title reads Scheme list - Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Reload the page.
Step Expected: The page reloads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading and the table column headings again.
Step Expected: The h1 is still View Schemes and the four columns are still shown.

Step Action: Look at the rows below the column headings.
Step Expected: At least one scheme row is still shown.

Title: Browser Back from the scheme list returns to Home
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Click the View schemes card.
Step Expected: The h1 reads View Schemes.

Step Action: Select the browser Back button.
Step Expected: The browser returns to the address path /Home.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look for the View schemes card under the Schemes section.
Step Expected: The View schemes card is still visible.
